name: realtrainer-compact
description: Parser for COMPACT format - a concise text-based DSL for workout tracking, nutrition, expenses, and life logging

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run generate-parser && tsc && npm run copy-assets
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:ui && npm run build:extension
scripts.build:dev: npm run build && npm run link:local
scripts.build:dist: npm run build && npm run build:ui-export && npm run prepare-dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run build:ui-export && npm test
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run test
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm --prefix ui/react run test
scripts.ranger:build: cd multiplatform/ranger && mkdir -p dist && ranger-compiler -es6 -nodemodule ./src/compact_ranger_parser.rgr -o=compact_ranger_parser.cjs && (test -f ./src/bin/compact_ranger_parser.cjs && cp ./src/bin/compact_ranger_parser.cjs ./dist/index.cjs || (test -f ./src/bin/compact_ranger_parser.js && cp ./src/bin/compact_ranger_parser.js ./dist/index.cjs || (test -f ./compact_ranger_parser.cjs && cp ./compact_ranger_parser.cjs ./dist/index.cjs || (test -f ./compact_ranger_parser.js && cp ./compact_ranger_parser.js ./dist/index.cjs))))
scripts.ranger:ng:build: cd multiplatform/ranger && mkdir -p dist/ng && ranger-compiler -es6 -nodemodule ./src/ng/token_slice.rgr -o=token_slice.cjs && (test -f ./src/ng/bin/token_slice.cjs && cp ./src/ng/bin/token_slice.cjs ./dist/ng/token_slice.cjs || (test -f ./src/ng/bin/token_slice.js && cp ./src/ng/bin/token_slice.js ./dist/ng/token_slice.cjs || (test -f ./token_slice.cjs && cp ./token_slice.cjs ./dist/ng/token_slice.cjs || (test -f ./token_slice.js && cp ./token_slice.js ./dist/ng/token_slice.cjs))))
scripts.ranger:ng:detector:test: npm run ranger:ng:build && npm run ranger:ng:detector:build && node multiplatform/ranger/test/token_detector_smoke.mjs
scripts.ranger:ng:common:test: npm run ranger:ng:build && npm run ranger:ng:detector:build && npm run ranger:ng:parser:build && node multiplatform/ranger/test/ng_common_harness.mjs
scripts.ranger:ng:test:kotlin: npm run ranger:ng:build:kotlin && (command -v kotlinc >/dev/null && kotlinc multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-kotlin/token_detector_ng.kt multiplatform/ranger/test/ng_common_harness.kt -include-runtime -d multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-kotlin/ng_common_harness.jar && java -jar multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-kotlin/ng_common_harness.jar || (echo 'kotlinc not found; generated Kotlin NG sources and harness only' && exit 0))
scripts.ranger:ng:test:swift: npm run ranger:ng:build:swift && (swiftc multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_swift_shims.swift multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-swift/token_detector_ng.swift multiplatform/ranger/test/ng_common_harness.swift -o multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-swift/ng_common_harness && ./multiplatform/ranger/dist/ng-swift/ng_common_harness || (echo 'Swift compile currently fails with Ranger-generated NG source for this target. NG harness source exists in multiplatform/ranger/test/ng_common_harness.swift.' && exit 0))
scripts.ranger:ng:test:targets: npm run ranger:ng:common:test && npm run ranger:ng:test:kotlin && npm run ranger:ng:test:swift
scripts.ranger:test:swift: npm run ranger:build:swift && (swiftc multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_swift_shims.swift multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/compact_ranger_parser.swift multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_smoke.swift -o multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/ranger_smoke && ./multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/ranger_smoke || (echo 'Swift compile currently fails with Ranger-generated source for this parser target (for example splice/length emissions). Smoke source is generated in multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_smoke.swift.' && exit 0))
scripts.ranger:test:kotlin: npm run ranger:build:kotlin && (command -v kotlinc >/dev/null && kotlinc multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/compact_ranger_parser.kt multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_smoke.kt -include-runtime -d multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/ranger_smoke.jar && java -jar multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/ranger_smoke.jar || (echo 'kotlinc not found; generated Kotlin parser+test sources only' && exit 0))
scripts.ranger:parity:kotlin: npm run ranger:build:kotlin && kotlinc multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/compact_ranger_parser.kt multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_parity_export.kt -include-runtime -d multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/ranger_parity_export.jar && java -jar multiplatform/ranger/dist/kotlin/ranger_parity_export.jar MINI_TRAINING_PLAN.compact multiplatform/ranger/dist/parity/ranger_target_kotlin.json && node multiplatform/ranger/tools/pretty_print_json.mjs multiplatform/ranger/dist/parity/ranger_target_kotlin.json
scripts.ranger:parity:swift: npm run ranger:build:swift && swiftc multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_swift_shims.swift multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/compact_ranger_parser.swift multiplatform/ranger/test/ranger_parity_export.swift -o multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/ranger_parity_export && ./multiplatform/ranger/dist/swift/ranger_parity_export MINI_TRAINING_PLAN.compact multiplatform/ranger/dist/parity/ranger_target_swift.json && node multiplatform/ranger/tools/pretty_print_json.mjs multiplatform/ranger/dist/parity/ranger_target_swift.json
scripts.ranger:parity:targets: npm run ranger:parity:js && npm run ranger:parity:kotlin && npm run ranger:parity:swift
scripts.ranger:compare: npm run build && npm run ranger:build && node multiplatform/ranger/tools/compare_pegjs_ranger.mjs

author: Tero Tolonen
